spells.name: Blink
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Distance variable DC
spells.effect: You use your control over time and space to reappear somewhere in close range in line of sight. You must announce the destination before rolling the skill and will fail if you do not meet the DC target. You keep your initial velocity and movement upon arrival.
spells.minor: You can teleport in any direction; the difficulty of this skill check is one per 5 meters teleported.
spells.intermediate: You can now use this power as a QUICK action. Power otherwise works the same as with the minor version
spells.major: You can teleport 15 meters in any direction; the difficulty of this skill check is one per additionnal 5 meters teleported.  This can be done as a QUICK action.
spells.mastery: Your teleportations are always safe and your teleport at speed 0.
spells.backlash: You teleport in a random valid direction (roll on deviation table) range is the same as what you would have travelled on success

spells.name: Blitz
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Reach across multiple dimentions to teleport and replicate your melee attacks in an area.
spells.minor: You teleport up to X meters(s) in any direction and perform a STANDARD melee attack the target.
spells.intermediate: Up to X targets in a line of up to X meters are hit by a STANDARD melee attack, you re-apear next to the last target you hit (make 1 melee attack and apply its result to all targets)
spells.major: Teleport to a target within X meters, you can repeat this action up to X times as long as the next target is within X meters of the previous one. All targets are hit by a STANDARD melee attack, you re-apear next to the last target you hit.
spells.mastery: After performing this power you can instantly teleport back to your starting position or next to any of the targets hit instead of the last one hit.
spells.backlash: You miss all targets and gain the STUNNED ailment on arrival

spells.name: Borrowed Time
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: You slow the time around yourself to greatly increase the time within an area.
spells.minor: You are SLOWED, up to X target within the area gain an additional MOVEMENT phase.
spells.intermediate: You are STUNNED, up to X targets within the area gains an additional STANDARD action.
spells.major: Invert the power, up to X targets in the area are SLOWED and you gain an additional MOVEMENT phase for every targets you slowed. (Unwilling targets have their WITS  defense).
spells.mastery: You automatically recover from the SLOW or STUNNED ailments caused by this power.
spells.backlash: You gain the STUNNED ailment.

spells.name: Co-Existance
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: Stop and record fragments of time and then replay them as you see fit. Your skill check DC is equal to the actions you are repeating (cummulative)
spells.minor: On using a QUICK action you can repeat your previous turn STANDARD action. This action must have the exact same target and results.
spells.intermediate: On using a QUICK action you can repeat your previous turn COMPLEX (or lesser) action. This action must have the exact same target and results.
spells.major: This effect cannot be sustained. On the round following the use of this power you appear twice, there is now two of you and both will act a full round on your turn. While both can act independently, any damage done to one is also done to the other.
spells.mastery: Repeating actions no longer cost you your QUICK action, they are now FREE ACTIONS.
spells.backlash: Co-Existance affects your closest enemy instead of you. If no enemy is preset, it affects your closest ally.

spells.name: Dimensionnal mastery
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: You bend time and space to gain control of the position of things around you.
spells.minor: During MAINTENANCE, you can teleport to anywhere within X meters of your starting position.
spells.intermediate: During MAINTENANCE, you can either teleport yourself or one object within X meters to anywhere within X meters of your starting position.  If the object is held by an unwilling target, WITS roll will reduce the distance of the teleported object.
spells.major: During MAINTENANCE, you can teleport yourself, others and any number of objects within X meters to anywhere within X meters of your starting position. If a target is unwilling your roll Vs. their WITS determines the distance.
spells.mastery: Dimentional mastery range is now 2 meters per success.
spells.backlash: Your closest opponent decides the result of your spell at next MAINTENANCE and continues to do so as long as the spell is SUSTAINED.

spells.name: Dimentional adept
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: Manipulate time and space to increase or decrease the range or radius of your next attack or spells.
spells.minor: Increase or decrease the range of an action by X times 10% (up to 100%).
spells.intermediate: Increase or decrease the range or radius of an action by X times 10% (up to 100%).
spells.major: Increase or decrease the range, radius or change the shape of an action by X times 10% (up to 100%).
spells.mastery: The effect can now be applied to a source originating from up to 50m from you.
spells.backlash: Effect work as normal but instead you get the opposite of what you wanted.

spells.name: Dimentional Mire
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Manipulates energy to slow time around the target.
spells.minor: If power succeeds the target is SLOWED.
spells.intermediate: You can now target up to 3 creatures within 20m, power is otherwise the same as with the minor version.
spells.major: Any targets that RECOVERS from the SLOW AILMENT caused by this power are DAZED until the end of their turn. Power otherwise works exactly as the INTERMEDIATE version.
spells.mastery: Hitting a target suffering from the SLOW ailment will recharge your QUICK action, this effect cannot occur more than once per round.
spells.backlash: You are now SLOWED

spells.name: Double Time
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: You borrow some time from the future to give you an extra edge on your actions.
spells.minor: Your MOVEMENT  action can now behave like a QUICK action (Can interupt, react and act anytime during the round)
spells.intermediate: All of your actions this round behave like QUICK actions, you can perform MOVEMENT, STANDARD or even a COMPLEX action as QUICK actions.
spells.major: All of your actions this round behave like QUICK actions and you always win INITIATIVE; you can perform MOVEMENT, STANDARD or even a COMPLEX action as QUICK actions.
spells.mastery: You can use this power on someone else within 10m
spells.backlash: You gain the DAZE ailment.

spells.name: One foot in the past
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: You store some of the present so that at any point in the future you can reach into the past to cancel something that just happened. Skill roll for this spell is done when the stored action is used.
spells.minor: You use and store a QUICK action: You can now end this power at any time to cancel another QUICK action. The DC of this spell is the skill roll result of the action you are attempting to cancel.
spells.intermediate: You use and store a STANDARD action: You can now end this power at any time to cancel another STANDARD, MOVEMENT or QUICK action. The DC of this spell is the skill roll result of the action you are attempting to cancel.
spells.major: You use and store a COMPLEX action: You can now end this power at any time to cancel any action. The DC of this spell is the skill roll result of the action you are attempting to cancel.
spells.mastery: You automatically succeed on the SPIRITUAL check if what you are cancelling is another CHRONOMANCY spell, power or effect.
spells.backlash: The spell works and in addition, for the next X rounds, during MAINTENANCE you randomly lose one of your actions (QUICK, MOVEMENT or STANDARD)

spells.name: Ordered Reality
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: You rearrange the dimentional properties of your surroundings so that everything is always exactly where you want it.
spells.minor: One target in range can be teleported by X meters. (Unwilling targets have their WITS  defense).
spells.intermediate: You can now affect up to X objects or targets that will be teleported by X meters. (Unwilling targets have their WITS  defense).
spells.major: You can now phase out items that do not fit your definition of the perfect space. Pick a number of targets to phase out, they will reappear once they recover from the PHASE AILMENT. Power otherwise works the same as the Intermediate version.
spells.mastery: You can now include yourself in this power but you do not count against the number of targets.
spells.backlash: You phase yourself out of reality for X rounds.

spells.name: Phase Mirror
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: You split your existence into many lesser fragments making it very hard to target you.
spells.minor: You split into multiple fragments, damage done to any of the fragment is reduced by X. Area and EX attacks are dangerous and you have VULNERABILITY 1 and take damage normally from those.
spells.intermediate: The fragments are now partially phased out or reality, you gain PHASING and a SMALL bonus to SPEED. Power is otherwise identical to the minor version.
spells.major: You alter the spell so that only one of the fragments is real. Damage is no longer split, it is instead ignored unless they hit the right fragment (1 chance in X). Power otherwise works the same as the minor version.
spells.mastery: While this power is in effect you can sacrifice a fragment as a free action to negate one ailment from affecting you (treat ailment as RECOVERED).
spells.backlash: You shatter your mind and body; set your curent HEALTH and MORALE to your total divided by this skills result,.

spells.name: Rending Bolt
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Creates a visible bolt of chi accelerated through time and space.
spells.minor: Target suffers 3D+4 [5] AR FORCE damage.
spells.intermediate: Target suffers 6D+4 [8] AR FORCE damage.
spells.major: Target suffers 3D+4 [5] AR - FULL AUTO FORCE damage. This power can now be used as a Full Auto action but requires a COMPLEX action.
spells.mastery: Targets hit by Rending bolt  gain VULNERABILITY 1 for each hit.
spells.backlash: Until the end of the SCENE all hits against you are ARMOR RENDING (AR)

spells.name: Shadow Cuts
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Your STANDARD martial arts attacks can now reach far away targets.
spells.minor: Your STANDARD martial arts attach reach is now X meters and a REACH weapon doubles your distance (2X)
spells.intermediate: Your STANDARD martial art attack reach is now 5m or 10m with a REACH weapon and you can apply your attack against a second target within range but this attack has a SMALL penality.
spells.major: Your STANDARD martial arts attack reach is now 5m or 10m with a REACH weapon and you can apply your attack against all targets within range but this attack has a LARGE penality.
spells.mastery: You can youse COMPLEX attacks with this power.
spells.backlash: Your weapon disapears in the shadow dimention for the entire SCENE, it reappears on your person after.

spells.name: Tachyon Strike
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: You open a conduit from another dimension to bombard your target with faster than light tachyon particles.
spells.minor: Target sufferss 3D+3 [6] INV+ BIO damage.
spells.intermediate: Target suffers 3D+5 [8] IGNORE COVER - INV+ BIO damage. Power now requires a COMPLEX action but the range is improved to anything you can see.
spells.major: Target suffers 3D+3 [6] BURST or FULL AUTO BIO damage. The conduit remains open for a longer time. You can now use this attack as a BURST or use a COMPLEX action to perform a FULL AUTO attack.
spells.mastery: The tachyon portal remains open for a short time. Damage done by this power gains the ONG special attribute.
spells.backlash: The FTL particles slip from your hand and affect you instead.

spells.name: Time Dilation
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: Whenever something you control or initiated happens you can delay the result. This skill cannot prevent targets from acting.
spells.minor: You can delay the result of an action or object by a number of rounds equal to your skill result (or minutes when outside of a challenge).
spells.intermediate: You can end the delay instantly as a FREE ACTION. Power otherwise works the same as with the minor version.
spells.major: Power can be used as a QUICK action. Power otherwise works the same as with the INTERMEDIATE version.
spells.mastery: You can now apply this effect to objects and effects that you do not control but are within 10m (SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE against unwilling targets).
spells.backlash: Power fails, effect happens immediately and will re-occur at a random time in the next 10 minutes (or rounds).

spells.name: Time Shard
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: This power allows you to alter the effects of the passage of time on yourself.
spells.minor: You trigger an immediate MAINTENANCE phase, apply everything that would happen during your maintenance phase including RECOVERY rolls.
spells.intermediate: You greatly speed up the passage of time around you; trigger up to X MAINTENANCE phases in this round.  Power otherwise behaves exactly like the minor effect.
spells.major: After using this power you immediately get a SHORT REST, treat this like an immediate MAINTENANCE phase however at the end of the SCENE you will now get the benefits of a SHORT REST.
spells.mastery: Power can now be used on any target within 10m (enemies are SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE)
spells.backlash: Until the end of the SCENE you only get a RECOVERY roll every other maintenance phase.

spells.name: Timespace Chaos
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL vs SPIRITUAL defense to apply AILMENT or effect.
spells.effect: You shift a target's reality to one where the timespace is non-linear. Targets will now either act twice or not at all.
spells.minor: One target in range now has their actions cancelled if their luck dice roll is an ODD number or have their action happen twice if the result is EVEN.
spells.intermediate: You now include yourself in this non-linear reality. Your round order is now defined by the target (you do not act until they do). Whenever the target does not act you will act twice, when the target acts twice you do not act. See minor version for additional details.
spells.major: You pick a really chaotic timespace, the target now has a LARGE penality when acting twice due to the extreme shifts in timespace. Power otherwise works the same as with the minor version.
spells.mastery: While a target is under this spell's effect your always win INITIATIVE checks against the target
spells.backlash: You anchor yourself to the wrong reality, until the end of the SCENE any time you roll an ODD number of your luck dice your action does not happen.

spells.name: Undo
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: With the help of time, you look into multiple realities untril you find one more favorable to your outcomes.
spells.minor: During the next round, you can reroll one of your skill check but the result is now limited by your SPIRITUAL skill result. Power ends once you have rerolled once or at the end of the round.
spells.intermediate: During the next round, all of your rolls are LUCKY but is now limited by your SPIRITUAL skill result.
spells.major: You can now apply this effect on 1 target within 10m and you decide if they are LUCKY (Limited by your skill check) for a round or UNLUCKY (Can resist with WITS DEFENSE).
spells.mastery: During a round where you are under the effect of Undo you ignore critical failures, opponents ignore critical successes.
spells.backlash: Gain UNLUCKY as an ailment (including your SAVES) that can be saved during MAINTENANCE.

spells.name: Warp
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: You bend space around an object, using several points of reality to squish them together and releasing them. Warp has the CRIT modifier against constructs and structures.
spells.minor: Target suffers 4D+2 [5] AS PHYSICAL damage.
spells.intermediate: Target suffers 3D+5 [7] AS CLOSE BLAST 5m PHYSICAL damage. Range changes to all in CLOSE BLAST 5m.
spells.major: Target suffers 3D+5 [7] AREA BURST 2m - AS PHYSICAL damage. Increase the range and output to: Area burst 2m within 25m
spells.mastery: Applies ONG on CRIT.
spells.backlash: You instead Warp yourself.

spells.name: Arc
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Bring an arc of lightning from void to that will deal EMP ENERGY damage in a line
spells.minor: All targets in path suffers 3D+2 [7] EMP ENERGY damage.
spells.intermediate: Change the arc so that it no longer travels in a line but instead pulses rapidly, power can now be used as a FULL AUTO action (COMPLEX) and hit multiple times for  3D+3 [8] FULL AUTO - EMP ENERGY damage.
spells.major: Supercharge the power; deals 3D+4 [10] FULL AUTO - EMP ENERGY damage and then jump to the nearest target reducing power by 1 in the process. Power will jump until power is depleted, it misses or no valid targets (targets cannot be hit more than once) remain in range.
spells.mastery: You can tap into an energy source to boost the Arc.  Tapping a single device (energy weapon, datacom, forcefield) for power renders it innactive to the rest of the SCENE but grants a SMALL bonus to damage and power. Permanent power sources (generator, power plant) will go out for a round but grant a LARGE bonus.
spells.backlash: For some weird reason the Arc always includes you as a target. This problem will persist for the entire SCENE.

spells.name: Explosion
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Use your chi to excite the molecules in a chosen area until they explode in a violent fashion.
spells.minor: Target suffers 3D+2 [6] ONG or EMP on Single Target ENERGY damage. You can use this power as a single target instead to add either ONG or EMP
spells.intermediate: Superheat the area, you now deal  6D+4 [8] ONG or EMP on Single Target ENERGY damage. You can use this power as a single target instead to add either ONG or EMP
spells.major: As a COMPLEX action you can create a fusion explosion; radius is improved to 5m and the damage is now 3D+4 [10] ONG or EMP or XAR on Single Target ENERGY damage. You can use this power as a single target instead to add either ONG, EMP or XAR.
spells.mastery: Aftershock; whenever the explosion kills a target the release of the target's own energy causes a secondary explosion to occur at the same spot
spells.backlash: Explosion detonates inside you, it no longer has a radius, only you take the damage.

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Pick a target within 25m. The poor target will burst into flames and set fire to anyone or anything standing within 2m. The fire will gradually intensify.
spells.minor: Target and the area around him suffers 3D+2 [4]  ENERGY damage. If this power is sustained the following round the power goes up by 4 up to a maximum of 12.
spells.intermediate: The heat  now melts away defenses, targets gain VULNERABILITY 1 on hit, this value increase by 1 for every round they are subjected to this effect. Power otherwise works the same as with the minor version.
spells.major: Target and the area around him are incinerated dealing  5D+2 [10]  ENERGY damage. If this power is sustained the following round the power goes up by 5 up to a maximum of 20.
spells.mastery: You also burn out the air from the area, targets will begin suffocating, gain the SICK AILMENT and will automatically lose 1 HEALTH every maintenance while under the effect of this spell. Negate this if the targets does not need to breathe.
spells.backlash: Power runs wild and deals its damage to everything in burst 5 of you, including yourself.

spells.name: Jolt
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Send a bolt of raw energy hurtling towards your target
spells.minor: Two targets suffers 4D+1 [7]  ENERGY damage.
spells.intermediate: Empower the bolt with raw kinetic energy targets now take  4D+2 Medium ENERGY damage. After the hit they knocked down if they take any unsaved damage.
spells.major: Generate a swarm of energy bolts dealing 4D+1 Medium FULL AUTO ENERGY damage with 6 Expertise that you can distribute as you see fit to any target in range.
spells.mastery: You can add a LARGE bonus to power and damage
spells.backlash: You become an energy magnet, until the end of the SCENE any energy attack that hits a target within 3m of you has a 50% chance to instead target you.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Weight
spells.effect: Manipulate gravitational energy to reduce your weight or the weight of items and possibly fly.
spells.minor: Allows to carry 1 extra item. Difficulty of the SPELL is equal to the item carried. (Small = 1, Medium=2, Large=3, X-Large=4, etc…)
spells.intermediate: Reduce falling damage by HALF, if your SKILL roll result is 5+, you take no falling damage.
spells.major: Further reduce your weight by including your own body in the equation, you now reduce your entire mass including items by X times 20%. If this exceeds 100% you now float and with some kind of propulsion you could fly.
spells.mastery: This power will now affect anyone you are in contact with in addition to yourself.
spells.backlash: If the target is a living target, the target is STUNNED. If the target was a non-living object see their weight multiplied by 5 until the end of the SCENE.

spells.name: Nova Blast
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Some elementalist are rumored to have perfected and hidden a way of tapping the energy of the stars and channeling the power through their body.
spells.minor: Focus your gaze on a point far away and let rip the raw power boiling inside of you, everything in the path of the beam take:  5D+3 EXTREME DP ENERGY damage. The elementalist also takes the same damage.
spells.intermediate: Focus your gaze on a point far away and let rip the raw power boiling inside of you, everything in the path of the beam take:  8D+4  EXTREME DP ENERGY damage. The elementalist also takes the same damage.
spells.major: Everything in a line up to the furtest point the elementalist can see gets obliterated in a giant blast of nova energy, everything in the path takes 10D+10 EXTREME DP ENERGY damage.  The elementalist also takes the same damage.
spells.mastery: This power only deals half damage and is not DP against yourself.
spells.backlash: The power boils from within you and explodes from every orifice within your body. Power deals all of its damage in a 10m radius radiating from you. Damage to yourself is XAR.

spells.name: Ride the lightning.
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs DISTANCE
spells.effect: Some elementalists have learned ways to transform their body into pure energy allowing them to travel through energy.
spells.minor: Move from energy entry point and exit at another other entry point, you can travel a maximum of 10m per success. If you do not have enough successes to reach the exit point the power fails. This energy can be also be temporary like an energy weapon attack.
spells.intermediate: You can bring a target you are touching along the ride with you. Power is otherwise identical to the minor version.
spells.major: You can invoke this power as a COMPLEX action to allow it to be SUSTAINED. Power works exactly as the minor version but if you fail to reach your exit point you can sustain and keep going the following rounds.
spells.mastery: You are now very confortable with riding currents. This power can now be done as a QUICK action unless stated otherwise.
spells.backlash: You enter the energy state but get lost, every maintenance roll 1d10 on a 8, 9 or 10 you manage to find your way back, until that happens you are incapable of doing anything else.

spells.name: Shockwave
spells.type: ELEMENTALIST RANGE ATTACK AREA AILMENT FORCE
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: A generate a massive clash of energy at a designated point causing a shockwave.
spells.minor: All targets within affected area knocked down. If the skill result also exceed their ENDURANCE treshold targets are DAZED.
spells.intermediate: All target withing affected area are hit by a 4D+3 MEDIUM FORCE  attack, if your skill result exceed the target's ENDURANCE they are thrown back 2 meters from the point of origin.
spells.major: Range of this power is now close burst 5m, everyone withing the area are hit by a 4D+3 MEDIUM FORCE  attack, if your skill result exceed the target's ENDURANCE they are thrown back outside of the radius (up to 10m).
spells.mastery: This power gains the CRITICAL keyword and on a critical hit apply the STUNNED ailment in addition to the usual effects.
spells.backlash: Power implodes at point blank next to you, you suffer the effects of this power and are also DEAF until you take an extended rest.

spells.name: Shove
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Generate a blow made of pure energy to swat your targets away.
spells.minor: Push the target away from you 1 meters per success. Targets are KNOCKED DOWN.
spells.intermediate: Move the target in any direction (including up), 1 meter per success. Should you chose up the target takes fall damage.
spells.major: You can now grab the target and SUSTAIN this power; this grab counts as ATHLETICS, PHYSICAL 8. You can move the grabbed target anywhere within 5m, you can also use it as a melee attack with a REACH of 5m (3D + 3 LOW PHYSICAL damage to both the grabbed and attacked targets).
spells.mastery: Any targets hit by this power are automatically knocked PRONE.
spells.backlash: Power colapse on you, you are knocked down and dazed.

spells.name: Singularity
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL vs ATHLETICS skill check
spells.effect: You combine various forces to create a singularity at a designated point. The singularity will pull everything inside its radius onto itself.
spells.minor: When the singularity opens, everyone in range gets puled inside the area and cannot escape without a DC X ATHLETIC check.
spells.intermediate: The singularity now crushes its targets squeezing the very essence out of people. Everyone in the area takes 7D+0 LOW XAR PHYSICAL damage.
spells.major: The singularity doubles in size and strength, everyone in 10m is grabbed.  Everyone in the area takes 7D+0 LOW XAR - VULNERABILITY 2 PHYSICAL damage and gain VULNERABILITY 2 to all damage.
spells.mastery: When someone in the singularity dies you gain 1 CHI.
spells.backlash: Your singularity fails and will open at a random point in time within the next SCENE at your very feet.

spells.name: Sonic Boom
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Create sonic detonation at a chosen point, the resulting sound is violent enough to incapacitate most targets.
spells.minor: Targets is DAZED
spells.intermediate: You can now use this power as COMPLEX action to change the DAZE into a STUNNED or perform the minor version of this ability as a QUICK action.
spells.major: Range changes to Everything in area 2m within 50m. The power otherwises works the same as the intermediate version.
spells.mastery: Targets hit by this power gain a VULNERABILITY 3 to ENERGY damage.
spells.backlash: You gain the DEAF and BLIND ailments. Those can be saved at MAINTENANCE.

spells.name: Supercharge me
spells.skill: roll SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Damage taken  for each charge stored.
spells.effect: Absorb the energy of attacks hitting you and use them to power your spells. The skill DC to gain a charge is equal to the damage taken.
spells.minor: While this effect is active you store 1 charge every time you are hit. This charge can be consumed to replace 1 point of CHI on an ELEMENTALIST power. The maximum charges you can store is 3
spells.intermediate: You can now use one stored charges to grant a LARGE bonus to any numeric value of an ELEMENTAL spell (one charge per value altered). Effect otherwise is identical to the minor version.
spells.major: You can spend a charge to maxmize the numeric value of any parameter of an ELEMENTAL power. Effect is otherwise the same as the minor version.
spells.mastery: Charges can now be consumed to recover 1 HEALTH or MORALE during a maintenance phase.
spells.backlash: Each charge gained now increase your vulnerability to ENERGY damage by 1, power is otherwise working normaly. Vulneratibility is treated as an ailment that can be savec at MAINTENANCE.

spells.name: Instant Therapy
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPEED DEFENSE
spells.effect: Attempt to "gently" zap a target's mind to help them recover their morale
spells.minor: You zap a target of your choice dealing:  4D+1 LOW  MORALE damage but recover X points of STUN damage if they take any damage from this attack.
spells.intermediate: Excercising extreme restraint you reduce your damage to STUN only. Power is otherwise the exact same as the minor version except that it deals STUN damage now.
spells.major: Increase the output of this power to deal with trully deranged individuals. Target now receives deals  6D+2 LOW  MORALE damage to target but recover from one MORALE TRAUMA and X points of morale if they take any damage from this ability.
spells.mastery: Because you really care about the well being of others this power is now XAR.
spells.backlash: The therapy fails, you deal max damage to the target and if they take any damage you lose the morale they would have gained.

spells.name: Cauterize
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WOUNDS
spells.effect: Master the power of energy and attempt to improve the conditions of a target by gently burning them into healtyness.
spells.minor: You energize a target of your choice dealing: 4D+1 LOW RECOVER ENERGY damage to target; if the target suffers any damage from this attack they automatically RECOVER from any ailment affecting them.
spells.intermediate: You energize a target of your choice dealing 4D+1 LOW  ENERGY damage and granting them X points of HEALTH recovery if they survive.
spells.major: Shock a target so hard that they might come back from the dead. One target of your choice takes 5D+3 LOW  ENERGY damage, if the result is not a TRAUMA they are reinvigorated and can recover from DYING, set target HEALTH to 0+X. If the target suffers a TRAUMA they are now trully dead.
spells.mastery: It's ALIVE!: Anyone that survives one of your loving cautherise, gain a additional LARGE bonus as HEALTH.
spells.backlash: Maybe you overdid it or maybe you just suck at this, target takes CRITICAL damage and you lose an amount of MORALE, equal to the damage dealth.

spells.name: Crush
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's PHYSICAL DEFENSE
spells.effect: Increase the mass of a target's defenses to crush them under their own defenses.
spells.minor: Affected targets have their armor increased to HEAVY  and are SLOWED, if their armor was already heavy they are IMMOBILIZED
spells.intermediate: Target's armor will now crush them, dealing X D damage POWER of this SKILL is equal to the TARGET's PHYSICAL DEFENSE VALUE
spells.major: You can now SUSTAIN the MINOR or INTERMEDIATE version of this power, while SUSTAINED, CRUSH becomes a QUICK action.
spells.mastery: Range increases to all targets in Burst 1m within 25m
spells.backlash: Your armor crushes you, suffer the effect of the intermediate version as an AILMENT.

spells.name: Detonate Corpses
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Your magic agitates the cells of a recently dead corpse (died within the curent SCENE) and uses escaping energy of the cadaver to produce an explosion.
spells.minor: Targeted cadaver explodes violently, dealing: 4D+2 MEDIUM PHYSICAL damage in 2m radius around the corpse.
spells.intermediate: Targeted cadaver erupts in a cloud of poison gas, dealing 4D+2 MEDIUM  GAS AREA 5m PHYSICAL damage in 5m radius around the corpse.
spells.major: Targeted cadaver explodes violently, dealing  4D+2 MEDIUM EX PHYSICAL AREA 2m PHYSICAL damage in 2m radius around the corpse. Any living being that dies from this power is retrigger the explosion on themselves.
spells.mastery: You can now use this power as a QUICK action.
spells.backlash: The power backfires, only you is affected by the spell. Number of hits is equal to the number of cadavers you would have detonated if you had not triggered a backlash.

spells.name: Devour Lifeforce
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPIRITUAL DEFENSE
spells.range: All living creatures in close Burst 3m
spells.effect: You explode the life force of every living thing around you, siphoning it away for your own benefit.
spells.minor: Target suffers 3D+2 [LOW]  SPIRITUAL HEALTH damage. You gain 1 HEALTH per target hit.
spells.intermediate: Target suffers 3D+2 [MEDIUM]  SPIRITUAL  HEALTH damage. You gain 1 HEALTH per target hit.
spells.major: Devour the life energy of those around you,  dealing  4D+3 [MEDIUM]  SPIRITUAL HEALTH damage to all within range. You recover HEALTH equal to the total damage dealt.
spells.mastery: At your choice, damage can gain the LIFEBANE (LB) special property, but you do not regain HEALTH from this power.
spells.backlash: You vomit copious amount of blood, lose an equivalent of HEALTH equal to the damage of the rank of the power you tried invoking and you are SICK until your next full rest.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's  PHYSICAL DEFENSE
spells.effect: You cause the bonds between a target's molecule to weaken and break reducing them to fine dust. Any target reduced to 0 HEALTH by Disintegrate, is considered DESTROYED.
spells.minor: Target suffers 2D+3 [MEDIUM] XFF PHYSICAL HEALTH damage with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action.
spells.intermediate: Target suffers 2D+3 [HIGH] XFF PHYSICAL HEALTH damage with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action. If the target is non living your also gain the LUCKY and CRIT special modifiers.
spells.major: Target takes 5D+5 [EXTREME] XFF PHYSICAL HEALTH damage with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action. If the target is non living your also gain the LUCKY and CRIT special modifiers.
spells.mastery: The disintegration lingers for a while before stopping. Add the ONG special modifier to the damage being done when using the COMPLEX version of this power.
spells.backlash: Apply this power's damage to yourself instead of the target.

spells.name: Vampiric Drain
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Damages your target's lifeforce by applying HEAMOPHILIA ailment. This ailment causes anyone dealing HEALTH damage to the target to recover 1 HEALTH.
spells.minor: Target suffers 4D+3 [LOW] PHYSICAL HEALTH damage.on hit with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action. Apply the HEAMOPHILIA ailment.
spells.intermediate: Target suffers 4D+3 [MEDIUM] PHYSICAL HEALTH damage on hit with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action, apply HEAMOPHILIA. If the target already has HAEMOPHILIA, you instead drain HEALTH equal to the damage dealt.
spells.major: Target suffers 4D+3 [MEDIUM] PHYSICAL HEALTH damage. When done as a COMPLEX action gain FULLAUTO at 3 EXPERTISE. Apply HEAMOPHILIA on hit, if the target already has HAEMOPHILIA, you instead drain HEALTH equal to the damage dealt.
spells.mastery: If you can touch the target, you can perform this attack as a touch attack and the damage gains  XAR + XFF.
spells.backlash: While any target has HEAMOPHILIA you also lose 1 HEALTH whenever they take damage.

spells.name: Dust Cloud
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.range: 1 target within 10m gains aura  X m
spells.effect: Generate a cloud of dust around you that obscures the visibility and conceals anyone inside.
spells.minor: Generate a smoke screen in the area, when used outside of COMBAT gain CONCEALMENT equal to your skill roll. Otherwise any actions that are done within or that targets someone within the area is treated as BLIND.
spells.intermediate: The dust cloud also acts as a GLITTER FIELD (GTF). Power is otherwise identical to the minor version.
spells.major: Increases the intensity of the cloud, anyone inside the area has a LARGE penalty to all actions, is SLOWED and BLIND. All other parameters are the same as the minor veersion.
spells.mastery: Dust Cloud can now be as large as 10m or as small as 1m, pick one size when you manifest this power the size persists throughout the duration of the sustain.
spells.backlash: You are BLIND, until the end of the SCENE

spells.name: Graviton
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Create a tiny graviton star at your designated point, The graviton will pull everything into its range crushing it with waves of gravity.
spells.minor: You create a minor star with a moderate pull. Targets in the area must succeed a DC X Athletic check (equal to your SPIRITUAL skill roll) or be pulled X m (equal to failures)  towards the center of the star.
spells.intermediate: Same as the minor power but if a target reaches the center of the star they takes 8D+0 [LOW] XAR PHYSICAL HEALTH damage.
spells.major: You create a full graviton, targets are now pulled, 5m per success (Vs ATHLETICS check). Power otherwise works exactly as the INTERMEDIATE version.
spells.mastery: The graviton pull can instead be changed to push, if a damaging version of this power was used, damage is only dealt if a target was pushed against a solid object.
spells.backlash: The graviton works as normal but is now centered on you… good luck.

spells.name: Healing Hands
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: You use your chi to heal the wounds of a living target.
spells.minor: You can use your SPIRITUAL skill roll to replace a MEDICINE skill check on a touched living target.
spells.intermediate: You restore 5D + 1 HEALTH to the target, instantly stabilizing a DYING target. The difficulty of this skill check is the missing HEALTH that the target has.
spells.major: Skill now requires a COMPLEX action. Restore 5D + 1 and remove one TRAUMA level from the target (MORTAL->GRAVE). Target that were DYING will also regain consciousness if their HEALTH is back to positive values.
spells.mastery: You can spend an amount of MORALE equal to your skill check to increase the amount healed by that value.
spells.backlash: You injure yourself and the target, take a GRAVE wound and target has their INJURY state worsen by 1 stage (Grave to Mortal or Mortal to Dying)

spells.name: Heamorage
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Tap into a target's current condition, reopening old wounds and aggravating current ones.
spells.minor: Target takes XD [LOW] PHYSICAL Damage. The value of X is equal to amount of MISSING HEALTH from the target, maximum 10.
spells.intermediate: Target takes XD [LOW] PHYSICAL Damage. The value of X is equal to amount of MISSING HEALTH from the target, maximum 10. Increase power to MEDIUM if the target has a TRAUMA or HIGH with a HEAVY TRAUMA.
spells.major: Target takes XD [LOW] PHYSICAL ONG Damage. The value of X is equal to amount of MISSING HEALTH from the target, maximum 10. Increase power to MEDIUM if the target has a TRAUMA or HIGH with a HEAVY TRAUMA.
spells.mastery: Targets receiving UNSAVED DAMAGE by Heamorage receives the BLEEDING AILMENT.
spells.backlash: Power works normaly but you take a HEALTH TRAUMA   You suffer the effect of the power instead based on your target's MISSING HEALTH

spells.name: Immortal Exchange
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: Gain complete control of your life force, allowing you to even bring the dead back to life.
spells.minor: As a QUICK action you can transfer up to X HEALTH to an ally within range.
spells.intermediate: As a QUICK INTERUPT action you can form a link between you and an ally absorbing up to X HEALTH damage that this ally would suffer.
spells.major: Bring back a DYING target back to life with X HEALTH. You lose an amount of HEALTH equal to the target's MAXIMUM HEALTH minux X + your ENDURANGE.
spells.mastery: You can use Immortal Exchange for MORALE instead of HEALTH, pick one. Replace all HEALTH keywords with MORALE if you do so.
spells.backlash: Power works as normal, double all HEALTH (or MORALE) losses incured to yourself by this power.

spells.name: Impact Shots
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Weapon Damage
spells.effect: One PHYSICAL DAMAGE weapon you touch is infused with CHI, granting it various benefits. This power lasts a scene or until the weapon is RELOADED.
spells.minor: Weapon gain a SMALL bonus to PHYSICAL damage. The DC of this skill is the number of damage dices the weapon has.
spells.intermediate: Weapon gain a LARGE bonus to PHYSICAL damage. The DC of this skill is the number of damage dices the weapon has.
spells.major: Weapon gain a SMALL bonus to PHYSICAL damage and your choice of (DP, AR or CRIT). The DC of this skill is the number of damage dices the weapon has.
spells.mastery: This power also grants a LARGE bonus to weapon EXPERTISE.
spells.backlash: The weapon and its ammo explodes, dealing its damage to the caster and anyone within 1m. Weapon is now unusable until repaired (SCENE).

spells.name: Impale
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Shatter the very ground raising it violently into spikes to impale your enemies
spells.minor: Target suffers 3D+3 [MEDIUM]  PHYSICAL damage.
spells.intermediate: Spikes now erupt from your position into a 10m long line. Anyone in that line takes  3D+3 [MEDIUM]  PHYSICAL damage.
spells.major: Spikes now erupt all around you and will hit everything in a 10m radius dealing  6D+5 [MEDIUM]  PHYSICAL damage. Targets receiving a TRAUMA injury from this effect are KNOCKED DOWN and BLEEDING.
spells.mastery: Add the Armor Rending (AR) and Defense Piercing (DP) tags to the damage being dealt by this power.
spells.backlash: The spikes now erupt from under you and will throw you in the air, you take the damage of the power and are KNOCKED DOWN + BLEEDING.

spells.name: Instant Blade
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: You grow a blade out of the material nearby and use it strike a target.
spells.minor: Perform a MELEE attack (with your SPIRITUAL skill result) target will take 4D+3 [MEDIUM]  PHYSICAL damage on hit.
spells.intermediate: The instant blade can now take melee weapon shape or form that you know and you get to add 1 special property of your choice to the attack (damage and power is per weapon type).
spells.major: Power / Damage is increased to 6D+4 [MEDIUM] CLOSE BURST 3m PHYSICAL damage and an additional range option of MELEE ATTACK on ALL IN CLOSE BURST 3m is available.
spells.mastery: You now gain the weapon's type EXPERTISE (or 3 if no value is specified)  value if instant blade is used as a COMPLEX action.
spells.backlash: Instead of disapearing after the attack the weapon fuses with a nearby surface, tethering you in place until you can break it. (Standard action DC5 Athletic or a total of 15 DMG Vs HIGH PHYSICAL DEFENSE)

spells.name: Matter manipulation
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: You manipulate matter to reinforce or soften its material.
spells.minor: As a QUICK action you alter the quality of a SMALL or MEDIUM item for a SCENE. Grant a LARGE bonus to the item's EXPERTISE. The DC of this spell is equal to the item's FINAL EXPERTISE value.
spells.intermediate: You can now perform this power at range and the item size is no longer limited. Target is now 1 target within 25m. Power is otherwise identical to the minor version.
spells.major: Modification to the item last for a DAY but should you fail your skill check the item is destroyed.  Power is otherwise identical to the minor version.
spells.mastery: You can now decrease the EXPERTISE value of an items instead of increasing it.
spells.backlash: Effect you wanted is backward

spells.name: Metamorphosis
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Evolution Traits
spells.effect: You temporarily modify your own body to immitate genetic evolution. The DC of this skill is the number of EVO points you have.
spells.minor: Gain a random Genetic EVO 1 trait.
spells.intermediate: Gain a random Genetic EVO 2 including the EVO 1 trait
spells.major: Gain a random Genetic EVO 3, including the EVO 1 and EVO 2 traits.
spells.mastery: You can pick the traits you want but double the DC.
spells.backlash: Your EVO traits are disabled until the end of the SCENE.

spells.name: Plague
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Corrupt the very being of a target causing their body to attack itself.
spells.minor: Target suffers 3D+2 [LOW] LIFEBANE PHYSICAL damage. Target gains the SICK AILMENT.
spells.intermediate: Improve the attack target now takes 5D+4 [LOW] ONG SICK PHYSICAL damage. Target gains the SICK AILMENT.
spells.major: Target now takes 5D+4 [MEDIUM] ONG SICK TARGET ALL IN 5m PHYSICAL damage. Target gains the SICK AILMENT. If this power kills the target the plague spreads to all creatures within 5m (repeat the attack against all targets).
spells.mastery: The SICK AILMENT lasts for a SCENE and cannot be recovered from.
spells.backlash: The plague spreads from you and every one within 10m of yourself take 5D + 4 [MEDIUM] ONG PHYSICAL damage and gains the SICK AILMENT.

spells.name: Purge
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Invigorate the target's immune system and physical defenses so it purges itself of outside elements. Can also be used to purge enemy buffs.
spells.minor: Remove 1 one random effect of your choice from the target (BUFF or AILMENT)
spells.intermediate: Remove all effects from the target (BUFF AND AILMENTS)
spells.major: Remove effects of your choice from the target (BUFFS or AILMENTS).
spells.mastery: Range changes to: All targets in a close burst 2m.
spells.backlash: Effects are removed from targets but also deal their full effect instantly to you. If you had any buffs they are transferred to the target.

spells.name: Raise the ground
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's ENDURANCE DEFENSE
spells.effect: Your magic raises the ground in your sight to create elevation and cover. The raised ground will revert to normal after a SCENE.
spells.minor: Create a line X m worth of BAD cover. See BAD cover rules for details.
spells.intermediate: Create a line X m worth of GOOD cover. See GOOD cover rules for details.
spells.major: Create a line X m worth of GOOD TOTAL cover. See GOOD and TOTAL cover rules for details.
spells.mastery: You are no longer restrained to a line. You can shape the COVER you create in any shape you want.
spells.backlash: You entomb yourself in a sinkhole, everyone had GOOD cover against you.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs ENDURANCE
spells.effect: You manipulate your own cells so they regenerate back to their original condition.
spells.minor: During MAINTENANCE, you recover 1 HEALTH if you took damage from an attack in the previous round.
spells.intermediate: During MAINTENANCE, you recover 1 HEALTH if you took damage from an attack in the previous round, this value is tripled if you spent CHI in that round.
spells.major: During MAINTENANCE, you recover 1 HEALTH if you took damage from an attack in the previous round. You also recover from a TRAUMA.
spells.mastery: You regenerate 2 HEALTH instead of the regular 1 HEALTH.
spells.backlash: Your cells completely freak out and you cannot gain HEALTH for the remainder of the SCENE.

spells.name: Reinforce
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Deflect
spells.effect: Your reinforces your body and armor to prevent damage.
spells.minor: Your ARMOR SOAK rolls are now LUCKY.
spells.intermediate: Your ARMOR SOAK rolls are now LUCKY and your ARMOR PHYSICAL DEFENSE is set to HIGH (no effect if armor is already HIGH or EXTREME).
spells.major: Reduce the power of the attack that hit you to [LOW], you also have AEGIS against that attack.
spells.mastery: Initiative rolls to use this power as an IMMEDIATE INTERUPT are lucky
spells.backlash: Until the end of the SCENE your SOAK rolls are unlucky

spells.name: Reshape
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Variable
spells.effect: You can transform non living materials into other non living raw materials. The resulting materials can be used to replace a SALVAGE skill check or any other skill you can think of.
spells.minor: You can transform X units (a unit is a small or 5kg) of a material type into any other material type. You must have a sample of both materials.
spells.intermediate: You can transform X units (a unit is a small or 5kg) of a material type into any other material type. You do not need a sample of either materials.
spells.major: You can transform X units (a unit is a small or 5kg) of a material type into any other materials. The result can take the shape of your choice. If used to create items you must still use an ENGINEERING check and spend the required time.
spells.mastery: Reshape can now be used to shape and form living matter.
spells.backlash: You destroy all source materials used in this power.

spells.name: Unbalance
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Item EXPERTISE
spells.effect: You curse a target so that their items reliability drop drastically. The skill DC is determined by the item's EXPERTISE.
spells.minor: One of the user's items now fails on a CRITICAL roll of 1 to 3.
spells.intermediate: One of the user's items now fails on a CRITICAL roll of 1 to 3. If the result was already a natural Critical failure the item breaks.
spells.major: One of the user's items now automatically fails unless a critical success is rolled for as long as you sustain this power.
spells.mastery: You can curse up to 3 targets within range but doing so changes this power to a CURSE AILMENT. (Cannot be sustained).
spells.backlash: All of your items are also the subject of this power.

spells.name: Unbreakeable Skin
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs SOAK
spells.effect: You reinforce your skin by reforming the composition to be almost impossible to break.
spells.minor: You gain HARD and MASTERWORK against any attack where the DAMAGE does not exceed you skill result.
spells.intermediate: You gain HARD, MASTERWORK and TRAUMA immunity against any attack where the DAMAGE does not exceed you skill result.
spells.major: You can now use this power on a target you are touching.  Power otherwises works the same as the intermediate version.
spells.mastery: Add your ENDURANCE value to the SKILL result.
spells.backlash: Until the end of the SCENE you are BREACHED

spells.name: Weaken
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's SPIRITUAL defense
spells.effect: Sap the life force of a target greatly weakening them.
spells.minor: One target of your choice loses X of your choice of either PHYSICAL, MENTAL, SOCIAL or ACUITY, this applies the WEAKEN AILMENT and can be recovered as normal during MAINTENANCE.
spells.intermediate: One target of your choice loses X of all PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES; this applies the WEAKEN AILMENT and can be recovered as normal during MAINTENANCE.
spells.major: 3 targets of your choice loses X of all PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES; this applies the WEAKEN AILMENT and can be recovered as normal during MAINTENANCE.
spells.mastery: Stats loss from a drained target are transferred to yourself or an ally within range. Multiple applications do not stack.
spells.backlash: The WEAKEN ailment is instead applied to you.

spells.name: Your pain unto me
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Missing HEALTH
spells.effect: Transfer wounds from others unto yourself.
spells.minor: Transfer up to 5 wounds from a target you touch to yourself, you lose 2 HEALTH per wound you absorb. You can then roll your skill check to prevent the damage if your skill roll is higher.
spells.intermediate: Grave and Mortal wounds can also be transferred and reduced by 1 stage if you skill roll exceeds the damage transfer (DC 5 is no damage was transferred). Power is otherwise identical to the the minor version.
spells.major: Transfer up to 5 wounds from a target you touch to yourself, you take 2 STUN damage per wound you absorb. You can then roll your skill check to prevent the damage if your skill roll is higher.
spells.mastery: You can now use this power on any target within 10 meters.
spells.backlash: You and all those affected by the spell now have the same WOUND total and conditions as the highest wound in range.

spells.name: Aura of Death
spells.type: SOOTHSAYER AREA RANGED ATTACK CHI MORALE
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.range: Every living thing (including caster) in close burst 15m
spells.effect: You create an area of dead CHI. All living creatures in the area take X MORALE damage as their CHI is destroyed. The value of X is equal to the target's current CHI.
spells.minor: Everyone takes XD [LOW] MORALE damage. Where X is equal to their CHI.
spells.intermediate: Range changes to one single target within 15m. Deal XD  [HIGH] MORALE damage and target loses CHI for every point of MORALE loss.
spells.major: Acts as the  minor power but anyone that has suffered MORALE damage loose an equal amount of CHI. lost CHI from this power also causes everyone else in the area to lose 1 MORALE.
spells.mastery: You never lose more than 1 CHI when invoking this power.
spells.backlash: Your CHI detonates, you lose all CHI and everyone (including yourself) in the area loses an amount of MORALE equal to the CHI you just lost.

spells.name: Cursed CHI
spells.type: SOOTHSAYER CURSE AILMENT CHI FORCE EXPLOSION RELIC
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Curse a target's CHI : If they try to use any powers requiring CHI or a RELIC the release of power detonates dealing damage all around them.
spells.minor: While under the effect of this AILMENT, using a power immediately causes an explosion dealing 5D+3 [LOW] AILMENT EX 5m ENERGY damage in a 5m radius centered on the user.
spells.intermediate: The CHI detonation also removes any SUSTAIN or BUFFs that the target has, power is otherwise identical to the minor effect.
spells.major: Empower the curse so that the explosion now deals 8D+6 [MEDIUM] AILMENT EX 10m ENERGY damage in a 10m radius, power is otherwise identical to the minor effect.
spells.mastery: You are unaffected by the CHI explosion if you are in radius.
spells.backlash: Your CHI is also cursed, apply the AILMENT to yourself and you trigger an immediate explosion.

spells.name: Death Curse
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Influence the odds of something bad happening to a target or item.
spells.minor: Target gains VULNERABILITY 3 against all damage sources
spells.intermediate: Target gains VULNERABILITY 3 against all damage sources and grants BREACHED.
spells.major: Target gains VULNERABILITY 3 against all damage sources, grants improved critical strike range and is BREACHED.
spells.mastery: Can be cast as a COMPLEX action to curse an additional target.
spells.backlash: Whenever a target(s) under death curse takes damage, you suffer an equivalent amount of MORALE damage.

spells.name: Derp!
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Derp! Is a curse that causes those affected to temporarily forget a skill and have to resort to using other skills.
spells.minor: Target loses the usage of the last skill they used until they recover from this AILMENT.
spells.intermediate: Targets is now any number of creatures within 10m, power is otherwise identical to the minor effect.
spells.major: Empower the curse so that any skill used while under the DERP! AILMENT are also forgotten until the target recovers from it.
spells.mastery: Recovery rolls from the DERP! AILMENT are UNLUCKY.
spells.backlash: Target(s) of the spell is/are chosen by the game master.

spells.name: Destructive Entropy
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Curse a target so you feed on their despair. When anyone under the curse makes a roll and fail, they lose morale and you gain a SMALL bonus your next roll.
spells.minor: Targets missing a skill check or roll will lose 1 MORALE (cannot be prevented in any way), you gain a SMALL bonus on your next action.
spells.intermediate: You can now curse up to 5 targets, effect remains the same as the minor one.
spells.major: Improve the curse, you now drain the MORALE loss and recover it yourself; gaining morale that way grants you a LARGE bonus to all of your actions until next maintenance.
spells.mastery: Enemies attempting to RECOVER from this CURSE are now UNLUCKY
spells.backlash: Until the end of the SCENE whenever you fail a skill check all opponents in range will gain 1 MORALE and a SMALL bonus to their actions.

spells.name: Dominate
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Gain control over a target. On your turn, as a QUICK action, you dictate how the target perform his actions. Target will act according to your commands. Effect will break if you pick actions that greatly contradicts a target's nature.
spells.minor: You can control a target's movement or force them to speak some words or shut up.
spells.intermediate: You can now control a target's standard action in addition to their movement and other basic functions.
spells.major: You gain complete control if a target; you now decide how the target spends his actions during a round.
spells.mastery: This power now has a 5m range
spells.backlash: Power backfires, for the next X rounds (or minutes) you will obey the commands and suggestions of anyone around you.

spells.name: Doom
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Curse a target to cause them to seriously doubt their capabilities resulting in various skill penalties.
spells.minor: Affected target has a LARGE penalty to a skill or action of your choice
spells.intermediate: Doom is now a QUICK action, power is otherwise identical to the minor effect.
spells.major: Target now has a LARGE penalty to all SKILLS and DEFENSES.
spells.mastery: Recovery rolls from the DOOM AILMENT are UNLUCKY.
spells.backlash: While DOOM is in effect you lose 1 MORALE each time the target fails a roll influenced by the Doom curse.

spells.name: Enlightenment
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: While active, this buff lets affected allies use your MENTAL or SOCIAL attributes instead of their own.
spells.minor: One ally within 10m can use your MENTAL or SOCIAL SKILLS values instead of their own.
spells.intermediate: All allies within 100m can use your MENTAL or SOCIAL SKILL values instead of their own.
spells.major: All allies within 100m can use your MENTAL, SOCIAL SKILL values instead of their own and use your WITS and WILLPOWER DEFENSE instead of their own.
spells.mastery: Effect on allies will persist even if they exit the range. Effect ends immediately if you stop sustaining it.
spells.backlash: For the rest of the SCENE your MENTAL, SOCIAL, WITS and WILLPOWER attributes are reduced to match the lowest target within range.

spells.name: Eye for an eye
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Distribute your injuries as waves of entropic destruction causing decay to everything as your own body breaks down.
spells.minor: All in range failing their defense suffer 1 HEALTH and 1 MORALE as TRUE damage if their total is higher than yours.
spells.intermediate: All in range failing their defense get your current total of HEALTH and MORALE applied to themselves, replacing their current wounds or morale (cannot be mitigated).
spells.major: All in range failing their defense get your current total of HEALTH and MORALE applied to themselves including TRAUMA and AILMENTS, replacing their current wounds or morale.
spells.mastery: You can substract 1 target per extra chi spent in range.
spells.backlash: Range changes to everyone in burst 50m.

spells.name: Fate and Fortune
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs WITS defense
spells.effect: While this power is in effect, every time someone within the area has critical success gain a FORTUNE point. Lose FORTUNE points on critical faillure.
spells.minor: Pick one target witin range. During MAINTENANCE, if your FORTUNE count is positive, one of their actions this round is a critical success, if negative, one of their actions are critical faillures.
spells.intermediate: Same as the minor version but all of the target's actions that round are affected.
spells.major: Same as the intermediate effect except that if your FORTUNE count is at 5 during any maintenance you can drop the sustain to apply the following effect: All enemies within range suffer critical faillures on all actions this round, all allies have critical success.
spells.mastery: If at the end of a round in which you gained or lost FORTUNE charges, the total ends up at 0, you decide wether the targets of this spell have the positive or negative effect fopr the next round.
spells.backlash: Until the end of the SCENE you lose 1 MORALE whenever someone within 20m makes a critical faillure and gain 1 MORALE when on critical success.

spells.name: Forget
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.range: One living target in close burst 10m
spells.effect: Disappear from the collective minds of those around you, making them forget you actually exist. Power ends if you perform any actions that interacts with an affected target.
spells.minor: Target that fail their defense will completely ignore you and forget you very existence.
spells.intermediate: This power can now be used a QUICK action and range is now all targets in burst 10m.
spells.major: Range and number of targets of this power is now unlimited.
spells.mastery: You also gain a LARGE bonus to STEALTH skill checks against all targets even if they successfully defend against this power.
spells.backlash: Targets that have a line of sight to you, automatically detect you and treat you as suspicious.

spells.name: Living Nightmare
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Assault your enemies with nightmarish visions overwhelming their senses.
spells.minor: Target suffers 4D+3 [MEDIUM] MORALE damage. Target who have their mental threshold exceeded gain the SICK AILMENT for the next round.
spells.intermediate: All enemies in burst suffer 4D+3 [MEDIUM] MORALE damage. Targets who have their mental threshold exceeded gain the SICK AILMENT for the next round.
spells.major: Target suffers 6D+5 [HIGH] MORALE damage. If you cause a SCARED or BROKEN result the target will attack the closest target to them on the next round.
spells.mastery: A target taking damage from Living Nightmare suffers the FEAR ailment and cannot recover from any other AILMENT before recovering from FEAR.
spells.backlash: Range changes to every living creature within burst 25m, this includes the caster.

spells.name: Manifest Destiny
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.range: Any   *The range of this power can be anything that can satisfy the conditions.
spells.effect: Alter destiny by borrowing entropy. Set a condition, once met, you add an entropy bonus to the roll but you must immediately roll SPIRITUAL and compare it to the number of success needed or suffer the consequences.
spells.minor: Add a one time LARGE bonus or PENALTY to any roll once a specific condition is met (players choice). Afterwards, roll SPIRITUAL and compare it to the result of the roll (including bonus) or lose the difference as points of MORALE.
spells.intermediate: Power can be done as a QUICK action, power is otherwise the same as the minor version. Add a one time LARGE penalty to any roll once a specific condition is met (player's choice). Roll SOOTHSAYER and compare it to the result of the roll (before penalty) or loose the difference as points of MORALE.
spells.major: Add or Remove as many success as you want to any roll once a specific condition is met (players choice). Afterwards, roll SPIRITUAL and compare it to the result of the roll (including bonus). If you succeed you are fine, otherwise reality swallows you whole and you cease to exist.
spells.mastery: If you did not use Manifest Destiny for your own sake, you have a LARGE bonus to your SPIRITUAL roll.
spells.backlash: Destiny remains unchanged, power works as normal but bonus grants nothing; you suffer the negative consequences of what the bonus would have granted.

spells.name: Migraine
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Targets failing their DEFENSE checks will gain will take MORALE damage for each Regular or COMPLEX action they perform while the under the MIGRANE ailment.
spells.minor: Target suffers XD+0 [LOW] MIGRAINE MORALE damage.
spells.intermediate: Can curse an additional 2 targets within range
spells.major: Can curse an additional 2 targets within range and targets suffer a SMALL penalty to all of their DEFENSE.
spells.mastery: Targets that successfully resist or recover from this power still take the minor effect damage hit.
spells.backlash: Whenever any of the targets take MORALE damage while under the effect of this AILMENT, you an equivalent amount of MORALE damage.

spells.name: Mind cloak
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Conceal yourself, anyone that sees you must defend against your SPIRITUAL skill result or treat you as concealed. This power has no effects against anyone you are engaged in combat with.
spells.minor: Gain X CONCEALMENT type I (Visual) and III (Psychic).
spells.intermediate: A target or object of your choice within 50m will gain X CONCEALMENT type I (Visual) and III (Psychic).
spells.major: As an immediate interrupt gain X CONCEALMENT type I (Visual) and III (Psychic). This effect is no longer limited by combat.
spells.mastery: You can divide the CONCEALMENT result between as many targets (or objects) as you would like and it will stack with the target's own concealment, if any.
spells.backlash: The power fails and everyone that detects you gain the benefits of LOCK ON against you until the end of the scene

spells.name: Mind Rape
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Unleash all of your mental might to obliterate a target's mind, burrowing deep into their psyche, stealing their deepest secrets.
spells.minor: Target suffers 5D+4 [MEDIUM]  MORALE damage with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action. If the target does not suffer a MORALE TRAUMA result you lose 1 MORALE yourself.
spells.intermediate: Target suffers 5D+4 [MEDIUM]  MORALE damage with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action. If the target suffer a MORALE TRAUMA you gain access to all of their SKILLS until the end of the SCENE, otherwise you suffer a MORALE TRAUMA yourself.
spells.major: Target suffers 8D+7 [HIIGH]  MORALE damage with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action, if the target suffer a MORALE TRAUMA result you gain access to all of their skills until the end of the SCENE, otherwise you suffer a MORALE TRAUMA yourself.
spells.mastery: You can now SUSTAIN this power to keep access to the target's skills.
spells.backlash: You just let slip one of your deepest secrets. Until the end of the SCENE you have VULNERABILITY 3 against MORALE damage.

spells.name: Mirror of fate
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Bind your fate to the well being of another (can an object or person). Anything done to you applies to the target. Damage taken from Mirror or Fate cannot be mitigated in any way.
spells.minor: Up to X WOUNDS  per HIT you take are now split (round up) between you and the target. Should one of you die or be destroyed while this power is in effect you will both suffer a MAJOR TRAUMA.
spells.intermediate: Up to X WOUNDS or MORALE per HIT damage you take are now split (round up) between you and the target but the target must be a living target with a MORALE pool, power is otherwise identical to the minor effect. Should one of you die or be destroyed while this power is in effect you will both suffer a MAJOR TRAUMA.
spells.major: Up to X WOUNDS per HIT or MORALE you would take are ignored and are instead done directly to the target. If the target die or is destroyed while this power is in effect you suffer a MAJOR TRAUMA.
spells.mastery: Instead of a MAJOR TRAUMA from the target being destroyed / killed you instead suffer a TRAUMA.
spells.backlash: This power now lasts an entire SCENE and cannot be cancelled by not sustaining it

spells.name: Omen
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: Allows a glimpse of events to come, SOOTHSAYER result will grant various benefits. Any skill or effect from this power cannot exceed the SOOTHSAYER result.
spells.minor: Roll Vs Enemy WITS, on success you gain a LARGE bonus to the next defense check you will have to perform and recover 3 point of MORALE if you successfully defend.
spells.intermediate: During maintenance phase, make one skill check of your choice; over the course of the same round, if you use the same skill you can use that result instead of rolling.
spells.major: Note your SOOTHSAYER result, this roll can be used to replace any roll done during the next SCENE. This effect cannot be sustained.
spells.mastery: Omen can now be used as a Quick action instead of a COMPLEX one.
spells.backlash: Bad omens: Your next X rolls will be UNLUCKY.

spells.name: Psyblade
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Manifest a weapon made out of psychic energy. PSYBLADES can be used with either SPIRITUAL or MELEE WEAPONS when making melee attacks but do not benefit from the EXPERTISE of the weapon.
spells.minor: Create a saber out of psychic energy. Weapon deals: 4D+3 [MEDIUM]  MORALE damage.
spells.intermediate: Create a bow out of psychic energy along with X arrows. The bow has a range of 75m and deals 4D+3 [MEDIUM] CRIT MORALE damage. This power cannot be sustained but will last until all ammo is depleted or a scene, whichever comes first.
spells.major: Transform an existing non powered melee weapon into a Psyblade; weapon now has the benefits of both the normal weapon and the PSYBLADE and deals an equivalent amount of MORALE damage on top of any other damage type it already deals. SPIRITUAL can be used instead of MELEE WEAPONS for EXPERTISE.
spells.mastery: This power can now emulate any non powered melee weapon in existence. Pick a weapon type on casting and even manifest two for dual wielding purposes. Damage and Power and expertise of this power is the same as that of the chosen weapon type.
spells.backlash: Blade suffers a critical failure on the first attack, power ends and targets gets an immediate attack against you.

spells.name: Psychic Lash
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Perform a mental lashing towards the target's mind. This attack ignores BARRIERS.
spells.minor: Lash at the target causing  3D+5 [MEDIUM] XBB MORALE damage with up to 3 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action.
spells.intermediate: Power requires a COMPLEX action with 3 EXPERTISE  but you can now use the minor effect as a FULL AUTO action distributed among any targets within 25m.
spells.major: Target suffers 3D+5 [HIGH] XBB ONG MORALE damage from internal brain hemorrhage.
spells.mastery: When this power ignores a BARRIER you also add the BARRIER's SOAK or INTEGRITY to the POWER of this attack.
spells.backlash: Deal the same damage to yourself and instantly sets your BARRIER on recharge.

spells.name: Shared Agony
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.range: All Enemies or Allies in radius 10m
spells.effect: Allows the user to weaponize his pain or mitigate its effects.
spells.minor: Share your pain in an area dealing 3D + 1 [X] MORALE damage to all enemies in range. Power of this attack is equal to the amount of health you are missing.
spells.intermediate: One willing ALLY within range can make an ENDURANCE save DC = total health or morale you are missing; a success lets you ignore attribute penalties caused by those wounds for the entire scene.
spells.major: If anyone within range has a WOUND or MORALE based ailment you can touch them to inflict the same effect on all enemies in range that fail their defense check.
spells.mastery: This power has a SMALL bonus to your skill check if you are suffering from a GRAVE wound or SHAKEN and a LARGE bonus if you are MORTALY wounded or BROKEN.
spells.backlash: Power shares everyone's pain in the area with you; you take an amount of wounds and morale damage to put you at the same level of the lowest entity within range.

spells.name: Stun
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Perform a ranged mind blast attack that also cause the STUNNED ailment if the damage dealt to the target exceeds their WILLPOWER.
spells.minor: Target suffers 4D+3 [HIGH] STUN MORALE damage with 4 EXPERTISE if done as a COMPLEX action.
spells.intermediate: You can now target up to 3 targets within range and You can change the MORALE damage to be LETHAL if you desire and use a COMPLEX action as a FULL AUTO attack with 3 EXPERTISE..
spells.major: Power can now be performed as an Immediate Interrupt and affects everyone in a 20m radius.
spells.mastery: When using this power with RAW CHI you gain a LARGE bonus to the MORALE DAMAGE and POWER.
spells.backlash: Power affect you instead of target(s)

spells.name: Stupor
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll Vs Target's WITS DEFENSE
spells.effect: Assault the target's mind with a mass of random thoughts and emotions causing them to temporally lose concentration.
spells.minor: Target suffers from the SLEEP ailment. This ailment breaks immediately on any damage taken
spells.intermediate: Range is now choose X targets in close burst 5m.
spells.major: Damage will give an immediate recovery roll to the target. If the target does not RECOVER, target will remain asleep until they recover.
spells.mastery: Once the targets recovers from the SLEEP ailment (or when it is broken early) targets will gain the DAZED ailment.
spells.backlash: Spell affects you instead and allies within range.

spells.name: Twist of Fate
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: Generate points of entropy; they grant 1 extra dice to any roll, once used they are given to the game master to be used in the same SCENE against the player that used the entropy.
spells.minor: Generate X points of entropy.
spells.intermediate: Generate X points of entropy. You can now pass once on a roll the GM intended to use the points on, must be announced before the roll and cannot pass a second time.
spells.major: Generate a pool of X LUCKY point of entropy. When the enemy uses the additional points they are UNLUCKY.
spells.mastery: Entropy points can be shared with allies within 50m. If an ally uses a point the reverse entropy will affect them instead of you.
spells.backlash: Entropy points are instantly all used up and have no effect, the game master now has all of them to use against you.

spells.name: Uncanny Fortune
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: Whenever someone in range makes a roll with less success than what you rolled, once per turn they can gain the LUCKY modifier. (This effect cannot occur more than once per roll per creature and only affect skill rolls)
spells.minor: Roll SOOTHSAYER and note the result. Anyone in range rolling less than your result has, once per turn, the LUCKY modifier, granting them a reroll on all failures.
spells.intermediate: Grants the benefits of the minor power but without the once per turn limit. everyone in range also recovers 1 MORALE whenever they roll a check that exceeds your SOOTHSAYER result.
spells.major: Supercharge the entropy; All rolls under your own result are automatically SURGED. Power can no longer be SUSTAINED.  Power acts as the intermediate power but adding an increased critical range.
spells.mastery: Power only affects allies. Range changes to all allies within Aura 15m
spells.backlash: Everyone in aura range gain the UNLUCKY ailment until it is saved.

spells.name: Unity
spells.skill: SPIRITUAL Skill Roll
spells.effect: During this effect the affected targets acts as a Hive Mind sharing all of their knowledge together.
spells.minor: While this skill is in effect, any rolls made can be done with the highest SKILL rank of all the affected targets (Use the attributes of the person performing the skill). The maximum SKILL rank cannot exceed the SPIRITUAL roll result.
spells.intermediate: Effect can now be shared by all allies within 20m, power is otherwise identical to the minor effect.
spells.major: Unity also protects all affected targets from MORALE attacks by presenting the highest defense and dividing any damage post mitigation between targets, power is otherwise identical to the minor effect.
spells.mastery: You can now use Unity without including yourself.
spells.backlash: Instead of using the best reroll the party uses the worst roll, this power cannot be cancelled until all rolls are done.

spells.name: Continuance
spells.action: COMPLEX to manifest / MAINTENANCE to supress
spells.effect: Create a 8 INTEGRITY BARRIER. When the barrier breaks you instantly refresh your QUICK action if it was down.   Time has an habit of being easily manipulated to continue and repeat some actions.
spells.minor: Barrier now has a ROUND recharge but maximum INTEGRITY is reduced to 5  While this power is in effect, any standard action you repeat in a following turn can be done as a quick action instead.
spells.intermediate: While this power is in effect you refresh your QUICK action whenever the barrier takes damage  you take damage.
spells.major: When this barrier collapse you gain a STANDARD action in addition to refreshing your QUICK action. While this power is in effect, a COMPLEX action can be repeated as a STANDARD action and a STANDARD action can be repeated as a QUICK action.
spells.mastery: Initiative roll triggered by the QUICK action refresh are lucky while this power is active.  You can use this power on any ally within 10m instead of you.
spells.backlash: Power works but You lose the ability to perform QUICK actions until the end of the SCENE.

spells.name: Dimensional Shift
spells.action: STANDARD to manifest / MAINTENANCE to supress
spells.effect: Create a 8 SOAK / INTEGRITY BARRIER. On barrier break, you reality shift, disappearing from reality for 1 round as an instant Interrupt. While gone you can only perform move actions.  With this power, chronomancers learned to modify their physical position in the universe.
spells.minor: While barrier is recharging you gain a LARGE bonus to defenses against FORCE and PHYSICAL attacks. While this power is in effect, gain a free SHIFT action per turn done at MAINTENANCE.
