spells.intermediate: While this barrier is in effect, you can trigger the reality shift manually as a QUICK action. Doing so stops the sustain of this power. While this power is in effect, allies within X meters  gain a free SHIFT per turn done at MAINTENANCE.
spells.major: Barrier will recharge instantly once you come back from reality but the sustained effect ends.  While this power is active, you can a free MOVEMENT per turn done at MAINTENANCE.
spells.mastery: Power affects additional allies within 5m.  You can do the additionnal actions at anytime and not just during maintenance.
spells.backlash: Power works as normal but the reality shift causes you to reappear randomly within 100m of where you started (roll deviation table). Power works as normal but your additionnal movement is controlled by the closest enemy.

spells.name: Distortion
spells.action: QUICK to manifest / MAINTENANCE to supress
spells.effect: Create a 4 SOAK / INTEGRITY BARRIER. While not broken, this barrier grants a SMALL bonus to SPEED
spells.minor: While protected by the BARRIER you gain the effects of STEALTH and DISCRETE.
spells.intermediate: Barrier bonus to speed is now LARGE.
spells.major: When the barrier breaks you can instantly teleport 5m in any direction as a free action
spells.mastery: You can include anyone touching you inside this barrier instead of only yourself. They gain all benefits of this power.
spells.backlash: Barrier appears to work normally but every hit you take will be critical until the barrier is depleted.

spells.name: Gravity
spells.effect: Create a 4 SOAK BARRIER that forces gravity outward around you. Anyone striking you in MELEE while this barrier buff is active is thrown back X m per power of their attack.
spells.minor: Increase the strength of the barrier with even more gravity. SOAK is increased to 6 and you now INTEGRITY 3 as well.
spells.intermediate: Invert the polarity of your barrier, you no longer knock back but anyone in MELEE range is now stuck there unless they succeed a DC 5 Athletic check
spells.major: When this barrier breaks and begins recharging everyone in 10m is thrown to the ground and must succeed a DC5 Athletic check to get back up. Effect ends once the Gravity Shell has recharged.
spells.mastery: You can now control the direction enemies are thrown when they activate your barrier.
spells.backlash: On the first hit, the barrier colapses and you are thrown 4 meters in a random direction.

spells.name: Shield
spells.effect: Create a 8 INTEGRITY / SOAK BARRIER made of pure energy.  This spell can be used to create a force SHIELD in front of the spellcaster.
spells.minor: The shield can be extended to protect an area of 2m around you  Creates a shield in front of the spellcaster with X  soak and MEDIUM DEFENSE against all types with DEFLECTOR.
spells.intermediate: Any attacks from within the shield gain EMP and have their damage changed to ENERGY
spells.major: When your barrier is hit by an attack, you can manifest any elementalist spell as QUICK action.
spells.mastery: Barrier only loses 1point when hit by ENERGY damage.
spells.backlash: Your barrier  shield explodes in a spectacular fashion, anyone in 5m, including yourself take XD  [MEDIUM] ENERGY damage.

spells.name: Superconductor
spells.type: ELEMENTALIST BARRIER BUFF FORCEFIELD SOAK INTEGRITY
spells.effect: Improve an existing forcefield with various effects and modify it's SOAK so it also protects against INTEGRITY. This BARRIER allows a FORCEFIELD to be active at the same time.
spells.minor: Your gain a LARGE bonus to the SOAK value of an existing forcefield.
spells.intermediate: Modify an existing forcefield to be a shield, it now only protects from the front but no longer loses any SOAK from hits.
spells.major: Any forcefield you use will now act as a forcefield generator (10m) and the recharge is set to every round.
spells.mastery: Your forcefield is now immune to the effects of EMP
spells.backlash: Your forcefield explodes, applying the STUNNED ailment. It will take a well equipped shop and a SCENE to repair it.

spells.name: Anti-mater
spells.effect: Gain a barrier that grants 5 SOAK Vs PHYSICAL attacks only. Barrier has no other protection against other forms of damage.
spells.minor: Barrier instead grants 20 SOAK vs PHYSICAL attacks instead of the normal 5.
spells.intermediate: The barrier now prevents all physical damage (ignore damage) but power ends after negating 5 PHYSICAL hits no matter the damage.
spells.major: The barrier now has a 1m radius, anyone inside gain its protection but anyone crossing the threshold takes 5D + 5 [10] XFF PHYSICAL damage as the barrier disintegrate them.
spells.mastery: PHYSICAL attacks hitting the barrier never reduce SOAK by more than 1 point.
spells.backlash: The barriers explodes the first hit, everything in a 25m radius takes 5D + 5 [10] XFF PHYSICAL damage.

spells.name: Carapace
spells.effect: An atypical barrier that grants 4 SOAK / INTEGRITY, when the barrier is recharging Shutting down your barrier, your skin grows into an armored carapace granting armor  a LARGE bonus to DEFLECT and SOAK.
spells.minor: Modify the carapace, you lose the protection to INTEGRITY but the SOAK value is doubled to 8 points.
spells.intermediate: Your barrier now provide the LARGE bonus to DEFLECT and SOAK even when its not recharging.
spells.major: Carapace now also grants its LARGE bonus to WALL and INTEGRITY in addition to DEFLECT and SOAK.
spells.mastery: While Carapace is active you have the MASTERWORK effect.
spells.backlash: When the barrier breaks you are restrained and cannot move as the weight of the carapace crushes you.

spells.name: Lifeshield
spells.effect: Gain a 3 SOAK / INTEGRITY BARRIER. When barrier breaks, recover 3 HEALTH and 3 MORALE.
spells.minor: While lifeshield is not recharging your RECOVER rolls are LUCKY
spells.intermediate: Lifeshield is increased to 5 SOAK / INTEGRITY and your TRAUMA threshold have a LARGE bonus while the barrier is not recharging.
spells.major: While the barrier is not recharging you regenerate 1 HEALTH and MORALE during maintenance.
spells.mastery: If this BARRIER breaks while your HEALTH and MORALE are FULL, recover one TRAUMA instead.
spells.backlash: Reduce your maximum HEALTH by 5 points until the end of the SCENE

spells.name: Chaos
spells.action: QUICK to manifest / MAINTENANCE to supress
spells.effect: Create a 4 INTEGRITY BARRIER. When barrier breaks, opponent that broke the BARRIER has a LARGE penalty to their next action.
spells.minor: Barrier now has a SOAK equal to its INTEGRITY.
spells.intermediate: INTEGRITY of the BARRIER is increased to 9.
spells.major: The LARGE penalty to opponents hitting the barrier is now an AILMENT and will apply to all actions until it is removed or recovered from.
spells.mastery: Whenever someone is suffering from the LARGE penalty caused by this barrier you gain a LARGE bonus on any actions against them.
spells.backlash: You gain the FAILURE AILMENT until the end of the SCENE

spells.name: Discipline
spells.type: SOOTHSAYER BARRIER SOAK INTEGRITY HEALTH MORALE
spells.action: COMPLEX to manifest / MAINTENANCE to supress
spells.effect: Create a 4 SOAK/INTEGRITY BARRIER. While active, your damage threshold is based on the highest between your ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER.
spells.minor: When this BARRIER drops to 0 you recover 1 MORALE and 1 HEALTH.
spells.intermediate: As long as this BARRIER is not recharging, you automatically recovers from all status effects during MAINTENANCE.
spells.major: Any loss of HEALTH or MORALE is divided between the two pools as evenly as possible. In addition, losing any HEALTH or MORALE will instantly recharges this BARRIER to its full value.
spells.mastery: Your damage threshold is now the total of your ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER.
spells.backlash: Until the end of the SCENE, Any damage you take applies to both HEALTH AND MORALE.

spells.name: Luck
spells.action: QUICK to manifest / MAINTENANCE to supress
spells.effect: Create a 2 point SOAK/INTEGRITY BARRIER. When attacked, roll your luck dice, on success gain a LARGE bonus to the defense that was targeted.
spells.minor: Instead of a LARGE bonus the attack automatically fails, in the case luck did not favor you, the attack is a critical success.
spells.intermediate: Barrier SOAK/INTEGRITY is now 4 points and any damage received while it's active is always the minimal value.
spells.major: Barrier can take any number of hits and now acts a DAMAGE REDUCTION 2 against all damage sources.
spells.mastery: On luck roll failure you still receive a SMALL bonus to the targeted defense.
spells.backlash: Power fails and your luck dice is unlucky until the end of the scene.

spells.name: Pacification
spells.action: QUICK to manifest / MAINTENANCE to supress
spells.effect: Create a 3 point INTEGRITY barrier around you that will absorb some damage, enemies in MELEE now have to pass both your WITS and your SPEED in order to hit you.
spells.minor: The barrier now applies to ALL attacks and not just MELEE.
spells.intermediate: Barrier INTEGRITY is boosted to 6 points.
spells.major: Anyone wanting to attack you must sacrifice 1 MORALE to even attempt to do so; this morale loss cannot be prevented in any way.

spells.backlash: Enemies gain a LARGE bonus when attacking you until this Barrier is supressed.

magic_rules: SPELL and COUNTERPSPELL penalty for items (apply highest penalty)
Heavy Armors and Powered Armors
Items, up to medium size (largest item you have on you)
Large and Extra large items (largest item you have on you)

The SPELL penalty is calculated every scene, if you start a scene with a LARGE or Extra large item and then drop it the penalty stays for the entire scene, same goes for picking items during a SCENE, the penalty will not apply until the end of the SCENE.
* God cannot use any spells, powers or barriers from a different domain.
**9/3 for maximum spell =  9 spells maximum and 3 of them can be your secondary attribute
Your SPIRIT determines your FREE BARRIER, SPIRIT POWER(S) and Maximum spells.
A SPIRIT always starts with only 1 spell, its BARRIER and SPIRIT POWERS.
If you do not have a spirit you can't manifest spells or powers but you can use relics. Relics do not require SPIRIT
In order to acquire a spirit a player must either bind another spellcaster and kill him, try to call one using raw CHI or destroy a relic to manifest its spirit.
SPIRITS come from the various magic domains and are influenced to a degree by the other domains. Each SPIRIT except a GOD SPIRIT have are influenced by a primary and secondary domain.
Stronger SPIRITS need a PACT to be able to be bound.
Minor and Intermediate spirits are uncounscious forces that can be found everywhere RAW CHI exists.
Major and God SPIRITS are life-forms born out of RAW CHI that have sometimes a simple or complex mind of their own.
Binding another spellcaster's spirit
To bind a spirit you must succeed at a BINDING DC is set by the current CHI of the opponent.

Once bound. your target's spirit will be available to you once it's owner is dead; if you already have a spirit when that happens you can chose to replace yours or change your mind and let the spirit disappear.
Gaining a spirit by binding someone else's strips the new spirit of 1 random spell and is considered "enslaved" but the spirit domain, tier, barrier and spirit power and pact remain the same.
You can spend a standard action to undo a bind, the DC is the result of the initial BIND check.
You can also bind the spirit to a relic that has been prepared in advance instead of yourself. Spirit will then power the relic on the death of its owner, rules are otherwise the same.
To manifest a spirit from RAW chi and bind it to yourself, you must perform a SPIRITUAL skill check Vs DC value of the RAW CHI pool.
If you would rather bind the spirit to a RELIC replace the SPIRITUAL skill checks with BINDING ones. (Requires an appropriate relic to store the spirit).

The domain of the spirit being called is random, its tier and DC is based on the RAW chi pool (1-3 = Minor, 4-6 = Intermediate, 7-9 = Major and 10 = god), the barrier and spirit power are randomly rolled once the domain has been established.
Bringing a spirit from RAW chi always trigger a SPIRITUAL control check (or BINDING if binding it to a relic), if you succeed you gain the spirit, if you fail check the BACKLASH table
If you succeed you manifest the spirit and can take it as your own replacing any existing ones you have.
Acquiring a spirit by destroying a relic

You can perform a BINDING skill check to destroy a relic and acquire the spirit inside. Spirits acquired this way have their domain, barrier and spirit power predetermined but they come with no spells
DC of the binding check is the same as the one to make that relic. Only true relics can be used, relic shards do not contain a spirit.
If you fail the Binding, the relic is destroyed but you do not acquire the spirit.
Upgrading a SPIRIT to a higher tier
A spirit you own can be upgraded to a higher tier once it knows the maximum amount of spells it can.
To upgrade you perform the same steps as when calling a spirit with RAW chi however the minimum RAW CHI of the pool must meet the tier of the new spirit rank.
For example when upgrading from a Minor spirit to and Intermediate, you would need a minimum RAW chi pool of 4 (Minimum required to summon Intermediate spirits).
If you succeed your spirit gains the new rank, you will have to max out his new spells before you can attempt another upgrade. Should you fail, your spirit loses one of its spells
Upgrading spirits can only be done with RAW CHI. Otherwise you muse acquire a new spirit via Relic or be Binding someone else's spirit.

Intermediate spirits being upgraded to a major spirit will "awaken" the spirit.  Each awakened spirit (Major or God) takes a form of its down, depending on the environment where it was awakended, how the CHI was procured and what happened to it since being bound.
Major spirits cannot be upgraded to god spirit by normal means.   Each spirit that ascended to godhood had it's own unique way of doing so.
Major and God spirits require a PACT to be bound.
A pact can be achieved by two different ways :
1 - A pact can be achieved by a voluntary deal/pact done with the spirit during the binding /calling process.
2 - A pact can be achieved by enslaving the spirit against its will.
Going against the spirit's "moral code" can trigger control checks to cast spells.
Enslaved spirits never trigger unvoluntary control checks.
SPIRITS have different states of activity.
Changing state is done for free at MAINTENANCE
SPIRIT state can be raised or lowered 1 rank each for each MAINTENANCE (Suppressed->Passive->Awakened->Manifested)
Note: supressed spirits do not grant barriers
Each turn, the SPIRIT state must either be :  raised, reduced or maintained.
Barriers are always active when your SPIRIT is not SUPRESSED. NO roll is required  however Barriers minor, intermediate and major powers are a BUFF and require a SKILL check and to be SUSTAINED.
Spirit powers do not cost CHI, they do however require actions and are specific to your Spirit type.

Players by default have 5 CHI unless stated otherwise or modified by RACE / Backgrounds / EVO or Talents. Maximum CHI for anyone is 10, any CHI increase past that point are lost unless specified/temporary.
There is 2 types of CHI.  Personnal CHI and RAW CHI.

The environment provides a base RAW CHI pool and when any spell is cast using your own CHI, immediately add the personal CHI spent to the RAW CHI pool (this CHI is added even if the spells fails). This raw CHI pool persists for the duration of the scene or up to normally around 5 minutes (can be more, DM's choice).
CHI is restored when you take a short rest (typically 5 minutes of rest)
To cast a spell you can use your personal CHI or Raw CHI. Relics do not use CHI.
The RAW CHI pool can never exceed 10 CHI, any CHI added past that point is lost.
Casting spells from RAW CHI lowers the value of the raw CHI pool by that same amount.
Casting or maintaining spells with your own CHI follows normal rules. You only trigger a control check on a critical failure.

Any SPELL with a BUFF component or a SUSTAIN effect can be maintained. Every round during maintenance you announce if you SUSTAIN the effect or not. Players cannot have more than 1 SUSTAIN effect at a time. SUSTAINING an effect does not cost CHI.
Casting or maintaining spells with a relic's follows the same rules as above but also drains the relic rendering it inactive for a time period depending on the relic type, setting it on cooldown.
Spells cast using relics do not contribute CHI in the RAW pool. Critical failures using spell shards still triggers a control check.
When casting with RAW CHI you automatically trigger a control check; see control check below for details
Spells have 3 level of effects, each with it's own CHI cost :  Minor (1 CHI), Intermediate (2 CHI), Major (3 CHI)
Spells effects are each associated to a SPIRIT state. Casting a spell level while in the wrong SPIRIT state will modifiy CHI cost.
Minor -> Passive ,  Intermediate -> Awakened, Major->Manifested
Being in a superior state does not alter the CHI cost of lower level spells.
Example : casting a Major Spell while in the "Passive" state would have a cost of 5 CHI.   Casting a Minor spell while Manifested would still cost 1 CHI.
Casting from RAW CHI always costs the normal CHI cost  1/2/3

During any maintenance after a round where you have not used personal CHI, your spirit will lower its manifestation by 1 stage. You can spend 1 CHI as a free action during maintenance to prevent this from happening

Counter spell: To counter a spell a player must use a QUICK action to perform an immediate interrupt and win the INITIATIVE, followed by a SPIRITUAL skill check Vs other caster's result. Should either the initiative or spiritual check fail then they were either too slow or too weak to counter the effect.

Counter spell: Players who's spirit is using the same magic type as the caster (PRIMALIST,CHRONOMANCY, SOOTHSAYER, ELEMENTALIST) have a SMALL bonus and a LARGE bonus if the spirit has the exact same spell.
Counter spell : User can use binding to counterspell and put the spell in an empty relic or shard.
Control checks happened on two occasions :
A Control check requires a roll of SPIRITUAL (for spells) or BINDING (for relics) with the DC being equal to the total of the RAW CHI pool (Max 10) before the increase or decrease of the action.
If you fail your control check apply the backlash effect in the spell description
BACKLASH table (failed control checks)
To acquire new spells you can do the following 3 things: Absorb a counter spell, create a new one from RAW CHI or consume a relic shard.
In all 3 cases you must have a spirit with a free spell slot open or a relic shard before you can try to acquire any spells.
As a complex action you can sacrifice a spell to free up a spell slot.
If you successfully counter spell you gain the exact spell you countered.
Consuming a relic shards grant the exact same spell inside the shard with a successful BINDING check

Making a spell with RAW chi requires a SPIRITUAL control check. The value of the RAW chi pool determines what type of spell you can create. On success you acquire the spell, barrier or power, on failure nothing happens.
The RAW CHI pool determines the rarity of the spells, barriers and spirit powers you can acquire.
RAW CHI pool 1-2 : Random domain, COMMON powers only
RAW CHI pool 3-4 : Random domain COMMON and UNCOMMON powers only.
RAW CHI pool 5-6 : Random domain powers of up to RARE rarity or Specific Domain powers of up to UNCOMMON rarity
RAW CHI pool 7-8 : Random domain powers of up to LIMITED rarity or Specific Domain powers of up to RARE rarity
RAW CHI pool 9-10 : Random domain powers of up to CLASSIFIED rarity or Specific Domain powers of up to LIMITED rarity
Unique spells, barriers and powers cannot be acquired via raw CHI, they can be acquired by consuming a relic or counter spelling the effect.
If you have an empty relic shard that is ready to accept a spell you can store your newly acquired spell in there, in that case replace any SPIRITUAL skill checks with BINDING ones.

If you have an empty relic shard that is ready to accept a spell you can also store on of your spirit spell in there, in that case replace any SPIRITUAL skill checks with BINDING ones. Failure will break the shard and make the spirit loose this spell.
Relics come in two category, True relics and Relic shards.
Relic shards are single use items that contain a spell, that spell can be used by anyone with a successful BINDING check and it is destroyed after usage.
True Relics are permanent items that can be used once a day, granting various powers and benefits for a time.
If your true relic grants a passive benefits it is considered always active and automatically consumes your one use a day.
Should you have more than one true relic, you remain limited to one use a day as this is a personal limit and not a per relic limit.
When owning multiple true relics the player must chose which one is active, this cannot be changed outside of a full rest. In the case the player forgets to set it, pick the strongest relic.
All relics must be created by preparing an item to receive CHI.

Before creating a relic, you must first anoint it (spend the credits on making it truly spectacular) and roll your BINDING check. You must then carry that item and earn experience with it. Item earns experience at the same rate you do.
A relic can be any item you want but the cost of the base item is in addition to the relic's anointment cost
Relic shards are the easiest ones make but they cannot hold spirits. (see acquiring spells for other options)
Once the XP is fully gained, the relic is now fully primed and you recover the 1 CHI you spent for that relic. If the relic is destroyed before being completed, the player gains the CHI back.
Shard =  10 XP and 5000 Credits
Minor = 25 XP and 20000 Credits.
Intermediate = 100 XP and 100000  Credits.
Major = 200 XP and 2000000 Credits.
God =  cannot be gained by normal means

True relics that have the required XP and have been anointed are ready to receive a SPIRIT. See the spirit section for details. Should the BINDING check fail, the relic is DESTROYED and you must start over.
Once the item has enough experience you need to decide which type of relic you are creating (see table below).
When binding an item you find a source of CHI (spirits, magical sites, spells casters) to bind into it and then pick one of the powers that spirit grants as a item power

Some specialty shops might carry relics, prices for a blank relic will be around two times the preparation cost. The price will vary but start at around 10 times the prepartion cost for a filled relic (True Relic).

BLIND.name: Blind
BLIND.desc: BLIND applies a LARGE penalty to any ranged action or skill. Touch and Melee skills only have a SMALL penalty.

XAR.name: Ignore high armor defense
XAR.desc: Armor defense against this weapon cannot be better than MEDIUM.

XFF.name: Ignore high force fields defense
XFF.desc: Forcefield defense against this weapon cannot be better than MEDIUM.

XDT.name: Ignores high datacom defense
XDT.desc: Datacom defense against this weapon cannot be better than MEDIUM.

XBR.name: Ignores high barrier defenses
XBR.desc: Barrier defense against this weapon cannot be better than MEDIUM.

XALL.name: Ignores all defenses above MEDIUM
XALL.desc: Maximum defenses against this attack is [MEDIUM]

ONG.name: Ongoing Damage
ONG.desc: Reapply damage during maintenance phase. (No effect if damage was reduced to 0 prior to next maintenance phase)

INV+.name: Invisible +
INV+.desc: Same as INV but has no minimum range and also leaves 0 traces on any detection systems.

EXPLOSIVE.name: Explosive
EXPLOSIVE.desc: Weapon deals area damage, use FULL AUTO rules  (action type does not change)  against targets that are larger than playable characters.

EX.name: Explosive
EX.desc: Weapon deals area damage, use FULL AUTO rules  (action type does not change)  against targets that are larger than playable characters.

LB.name: Lifebane
LB.desc: Gain a LARGE damage bonus Vs LIVING targets. Critical ailment with LIFEBANE apply the SICK ailment, if the ailment is already present, deal a TRAUMA instead.

OLD.name: Archaic
OLD.desc: Weapon has almost no technology on board. EMP has no effect and negative or positive effect from HACKING, VIRUS and ROUTINES can not apply.

GAS.name: Gas attack
GAS.desc: Forcefield and Armor does not protect against this attack. If you are inside the cloud the effects apply. GAS duration is 1 Scene.

S.name: Smart Ammo
S.desc: You gain a SMALL bonus to HIT. If you have LOCKON you this bonus is LARGE instead.

SMART.name: Smart Ammo
SMART.desc: You gain a SMALL bonus to HIT. If you have LOCKON you this bonus is LARGE instead.

EMP.name: Electromagnetic Pulse
EMP.desc: Gain a LARGE damage bonus Vs ELECTRONICS. Applying a critical ailment with EMP effect stop an ELECTRONIC device from functionning or STUN it if it's an android or robot. If the AILMENT is already present for the android or robot, deal a TRAUMA instead.

MELT.name: Melting
MELT.desc: Successful hits have 60% chance (5+ on luck DICE) to apply the BREACHED AILMENT to your target.

AR.name: Armor Rending
AR.desc: Gain a SMALL bonus to PHYSICAL DAMAGE when hitting MEDIUM PHYSICAL DEFENSE. Bonus increases to LARGE against HIGH or EXTREME DEFENSE or against structures and objects.

FALLOFF.name: Falloff
FALLOFF.desc: Weapon behaves differently depending on range. See Shotguns rules for details.

STUN.name: Temporary Damage
STUN.desc: Temporary Damage (Recovery of STUN damage is per SCENE instead of per DAY)

INV.name: Discrete
INV.desc: Weapon can be used without breaking concealment when at 10+ meter range or above. LARGE penalty to concealment when used in closer range.

DEADLY.name: Hollow Points
DEADLY.desc: On critical hits gain a LARGE damage bonus.

DP.name: Defense Piercing
DP.desc: Target is considered BREACHED but comes with a SMALL penality to your damage.

NEEDLER.name: Needler
NEEDLER.desc: Weapon fires high velocity needles; crits automatically on a 9 or 10 and and has a SMALL bonus to damage on critical hits.

EFFICIENT.name: Efficient
EFFICIENT.desc: Weapon only consumes 1 AMMO per attack regardless of actions (FULL AUTO, BURST etc.)

X-ALL.name: Cross-All
X-ALL.desc: Maximum defenses against this attack is [MEDIUM].

OPT.name: Options
OPT.desc: Item can have 1 compatible option of any kind

OPT+.name: More options
OPT+.desc: Adds an option to any item. If the item already has options, this adds a 2nd one.

CRIT.name: High Critical
CRIT.desc: Weapon will crit on an unmodified 910 instead of a natural 10 on your luck dice.

BULKY.name: Weapon weights a lot
BULKY.desc: After every attack with this weapon you must spend a standard action doing anything else before you can attack with this weapon again.

FRAGILE.name: This item is easy to break or damage
FRAGILE.desc: On a critical faillure, the item is damaged; LARGE penalty to atk/dmg rolls made with the item. SCENE +50% of item value to repair. If damaged again before repairs, the item is destroyed.

GTF.name: Glitter field
GTF.desc: Any ENERGY attack that comes in contact with a Glitter field has its POWER reduced by one category and deals MINIMUM DAMAGE. Glitter field lasts 1 scene.

HOT.name: Weapon can overheat
HOT.desc: After using this weapon, gain the HOT AILMENT. Weapon will explode and deal its dmg to you if you roll a 1 on your LUCK dice shooting this weapon while the HOT AILMENT is active .

RECOIL.name: Weapon has heavy recoil
RECOIL.desc: Weapon incurs a cummulative penalty of +1 DC to all shots after the first. This penalty resets if you AIM or perform a STANDARD action that isin't shooting that weapon.

BRACE.name: Weapon needs to be braced before usage.
BRACE.desc: Weapon has a LARGE penalty to SKILL checks when not braced against a solid object or on a mount of some kind.

SPIRITBANE.name: Spiritbane
SPIRITBANE.desc: Gain a LARGE damage bonus Vs MAGICAL targets. Applying a critical ailment with a SPIRITBANE will reduce its MANIFESTATION level to the following depending on level :   Manifested or Awakened > Passive ,  Passive > Suppresed,  if the spirit MANIFESTATION level is already suppresed the  effect will cause a TRAUMA instead.

SB.name: Spiritbane
SB.desc: Gain a LARGE damage bonus Vs MAGICAL targets. Applying a critical ailment with a SPIRITBANE will reduce its MANIFESTATION level to the following depending on level :   Manifested or Awakened > Passive ,  Passive > Suppresed,  if the spirit MANIFESTATION level is already suppresed the  effect will cause a TRAUMA instead.

BREAKER.name: Improves hit resistance vs multi attacks
BREAKER.desc: Forcefield can only lose 1 charge per attack even when an attack cause multiple hits.

HE.name: High Explosive
HE.desc: Reduce explosion radius by 50% and but deals double the damage. (requires EX base mod)

FIRE.name: Incendiary
FIRE.desc: Successful hits have 60% chance (5+ on luck DICE) to ignite targets. Damage gains the ONG tag on successful ignite.

RELIC.name: Relic
RELIC.desc: Item is a MINOR relic pick one MINOR RELIC effect on item acquisition.

MULTI.name: Multi Attack
MULTI.desc: Weapon counts as Dual Wielding (Can perform double attacks).

QUICK.name: Quick Attack
QUICK.desc: Allows the weapons to perform a SIMPLE ATTACK as a QUICK action.

GRENADE.name: Grenade
GRENADE.desc: Allows weapon to be thrown as a QUICK action if already in hand, and weapon deals AOE EX DAMAGE. (See EXPLOSIVE for details)

BARRIER.name: Barriers defense scalling
BARRIER.desc: BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.

THROW.name: Throwing weapon
THROW.desc: Melee weapon can be thrown with a PROJECTILES skill check.

LOC.name: Shotguns
LOC.desc: Power is determined by target's range. HIGH at short range, MEDIUM at medium range and LOW at long range.

POWERED.name: Powered armors
POWERED.desc: Armor no longer reduces CARRYING CAPACITY but you now have a SMALL penalty to PHYSICAL and ACUITY SKILL checks. POWERED Armors are always Extra Large when not worn and count as ELECTRONICS vs EMP.

GAMBLER.name: High value, high variance and can be negative
GAMBLER.desc: Your SOAK has very high variance and can go into NEGATIVE values, (Increase damage taken when NEGATIVE)

KINETIC.name: Charge bonus
KINETIC.desc: If you CHARGE during any round where this defense was hit by a PHYSICAL attack you apply the attack you received to the recipient of the charge (if you receive multiple attacks, only apply the last one).

SPEED.name: Add speed to soak
SPEED.desc: While using this DEFENSE to SOAK attacks that target SPEED defense you add your SPEED result as guaranteed additionnal SOAK

DATACOM.name: Datacom device
DATACOM.desc: This item is a DATACOM. Its SYSTEM pool tracks device health. SYSTEM damage reduces both SYSTEM and the wielder's MORALE simultaneously. Wielder's WITS and WILLPOWER serve as the device's defensive stats. Defense ratings (PHYS/ENRG/TECH/SPRT) are fixed per device model. Counts as ELECTRONIC vs EMP.

ADAPTIVE.name: defense value high against last attack received
ADAPTIVE.desc: ADAPTIVE raises your defense to HIGH against any the last type of damage you were attacked by.

ENTROPIC.name: min soak is equal to RAW CHI
ENTROPIC.desc: This defense gains a MINIMUM SOAK value equal to the RAW CHI pool. This value cannot exceed the maximum SOAK value.

MOTIVATING.name: max soak vs morale attacks
MOTIVATING.desc: You have maximum SOAK value against MORALE attacks

ENERGIZING.name: max soak vs health attacks
ENERGIZING.desc: You have maximum SOAK value against HEALTH attacks

HEALTHY.name: doubles health or morale recovery
HEALTHY.desc: While this DEFENSE is active your life recovery from any source is doubled.

SUPPRESSIVE.name: max soak against splash damage
SUPPRESSIVE.desc: This defense has maximum SOAK value against any area damage where you are not the primary target.

TEK.name: Weapon has its offensive paramaters set by TEK Routines
TEK.desc: The POWER, DAMAGE and SPECIAL attributes of this weapon are set by your active TEK Routines

STASIS.name: automatically stabilize when dying
STASIS.desc: As soon as you enter the DYING stage (from either MORALE, HEALTH or TRAUMA) you automatically stabilize. You will only die if you take further damage or traumas.

INSULATING.name: Insulating
INSULATING.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against ENERGY attacks.

HACKPROOF.name: Hackproof
HACKPROOF.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against TECH attacks.

MASTERWORK.name: Masterwork
MASTERWORK.desc: Critical hits have no additional effects. Masterwork has no effect if the wearer is BREACHED.

SPACE.name: Space Rated
SPACE.desc: Device is rated for space and provides up to 8 hours of life support as well as magnetic boots. Treat character as having GRAVITY TRAINING when walking on compatible surfaces.

INNOCULATION.name: Innoculation
INNOCULATION.desc: Device protects against non lethal environmental hazards. Gain a LARGE bonus to skill rolls against lethal environmental hazards and ailments.

HARDENED.name: Hardened
HARDENED.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against PHYSICAL attacks.

DISCRETE.name: Discrete
DISCRETE.desc: You hardly register on electronic surveillance. You now always have passive concealment of 5 vs AI and Electronics.

STEALTH.name: Stealth
STEALTH.desc: Device is designed for covert ops and provides a SMALL bonus to STEALTH rolls.

PHASE.name: Phase
PHASE.desc: Phase you out of reality when attacked. Gain a 1 in 10 chance of negating any attack.

UNIVERSAL.name: Universal
UNIVERSAL.desc: Device can fit any of the alliance races. In the case of ARMOR, it can be put on or removed as a COMPLEX action.

DUELIST.name: Duelist
DUELIST.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against MELEE attacks.

SPIRITPROOF.name: Spiritproof
SPIRITPROOF.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against SPIRITUAL attacks.

SMUGGLER.name: Smuggler
SMUGGLER.desc: Can hide up to a small object. Provides passive concealment of 5 or a LARGE bonus to an active STEALTH roll.

LIVING.name: Living
LIVING.desc: Device automatically recovers 1 SYSTEM or NANITE per MAINTENANCE (player's choice).

NANOBOTS.name: Nanobots
NANOBOTS.desc: During maintenance phase you can spend any number of NANITES to reroll failed AILMENT saves.

BUNKER.name: Bunker
BUNKER.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when not moving. (Bonus applies during maintenance phase after a full round of no movement).

AEGIS.name: Aegis
AEGIS.desc: Special modifiers to damage or power (DEADLY, DP, AR, EMP etc.) have no effect vs this armor. Treat all damage at its base value.

ABSOLUTION.name: Absolution
ABSOLUTION.desc: You get maximum SOAK when a critical failure results in a SOAK roll (from a DEFENSE check or other checks).

CLOAK.name: Cloak
CLOAK.desc: Provides passive CONCEALMENT 3 type I and II. Passive concealment is 6 when not moving for a round.

SERVOS.name: Servos
SERVOS.desc: Your PHYSICAL attribute for ATHLETICS checks is 10. Device now counts as ELECTRONIC vs EMP.

NOVA.name: Nova
NOVA.desc: Once per SCENE as a FREE action, when this forcefield breaks you can deal 2D+4 [HIGH] STUN PHYSICAL damage to everyone in a 2m radius. Targets hit are pushed back 2m.

DEFLECTOR.name: Deflector
DEFLECTOR.desc: Forcefield can only be used when you succeed a PARRY against ranged or melee attacks. This FORCEFIELD never needs to RECHARGE and only counts as your DEFENSE if you succeed your PARRY.

HEALING.name: Healing
HEALING.desc: During MAINTENANCE you can spend any number of NANITES, or personal CHI to recover an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE.

EMERGENCY.name: Emergency
EMERGENCY.desc: Once per SCENE you can instantly recharge this FORCEFIELD as a FREE action.

FULLAUTO.name: Full Auto
FULLAUTO.desc: On a COMPLEX action you can perform a number of additional hits equal to your EXPERTISE result in addition to getting a damage bonus from it. You can distribute the hits among any valid targets inside the same range bracket as the initial target. If the weapon consumes AMMO this action cost 9 AMMO.
